Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Conroe for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from December 1 (Christmas Tree Lighting and Christmas Around the Square) through December 12 (Toby Powell Conroe Christmas Celebration and Downtown Conroe Christmas Parade), with December 4 (Christmas Over Conroe at West Conroe Baptist Church), December 5 (Christmas Festival at First Methodist Conroe) and December 9 (Pictures with Santa at The Table at Madeley) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Conroe

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Conroe
  • 5 free events, including Christmas Over Conroe, Christmas Festival at First Methodist Conroe and the Downtown Conroe Christmas Parade
  • Meet Santa: Pictures with Santa at The Table at Madeley, Toby Powell Conroe Christmas Celebration
  • Parades and tree lightings: Christmas Around the Square tree lighting, Downtown Conroe Christmas Parade, First Methodist tree lighting
  • Trains: a train at Christmas Over Conroe
  • Season: December 1 to December 12

Planning a bigger day out? Conroe families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Houston, which covers Zoo Lights at the Houston Zoo, The Nutcracker with Houston Ballet, skating with Santa at Discovery Green and the Polar Express train ride.
